translationRepairs: Early in Wude, the Hidden Crown Prince campaigned against Wang Shichong; Lin advanced a plan to persuade him; the Crown Prince brought him in to straighten the Classic Books Workshop and appointed him Armor-Cauldron Staff Officer of the Right Guard's Rate Command.

Early in Wude, the Hidden Crown Prince campaigned against Wang Shichong; Lin advanced a plan to persuade him; the Crown Prince brought him into the document office and appointed him Armor Section Administrator of the Right Guard's Rate Command.

直典書坊 is duty in the document office, not 'straighten the Classic Books Workshop', and 鎧曹參軍 is Armor Section Administrator, not 'Armor-Cauldron Staff Officer'. The proposal fixes those titles but drops 以策進說 and adds an unneeded (dian shufang) gloss; keep the original persuasion clause and the corrected offices.

Emperor Gaozong once reviewed prisoners; Lin's responses in divination and reply left nothing unspoken; the Emperor rejoiced and said: "The key to governing the state lies in using the law: if severe, people are maimed; if lenient, the guilty escape—only by striking the mean can it match Our intent."

Emperor Gaozong once reviewed prisoners; Lin's replies left nothing unspoken; the Emperor rejoiced and said: "The key to governing the state lies in using the law: if severe, people are maimed; if lenient, the guilty escape—only by striking the mean can it match Our intent."
In 錄囚 context, 占對 means answering the cases under review; 'divination and reply' invents a divinatory sense not present in the Chinese.
He ended his career as chief administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously honored as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
He ended his career as chief administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously honored as Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
贈太常卿 is a posthumous Court of Imperial Sacrifices ministership; 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness' would be 光祿大夫, not 太常卿.
He ended as Chief Administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously given Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
He ended as Chief Administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously given Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
Literal likewise misrenders 太常卿 as 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness'; Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices matches the office.
Pei became prefect of Tong Prefecture;
沛，同州刺史 states Pei held the Tongzhou prefecture; 'of Tong Prefecture' omits 刺史, which the parallel 潛，為魏州刺史 also makes explicit.
Lin's grandson Shaoshao, in the Shenlong era served as Erudite of the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
Lin's grandson Shaoshao, in the Shenlong era served as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
太常博士 is Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness' again confuses 太常 with 光祿大夫.
The empress refused but still demoted him in the historiography office.
The empress refused but still demoted him to a historiographer post.

猶坐史官 means he was still punished by assignment as historiographer; 'demoted him in the historiography office' wrongly suggests demotion while already serving there, whereas 'to a historiographer post' matches the Chinese.
Shang, whose style was Yisheng or Qiujing, came from a family that had lived in Xinzheng for two generations and thus became a native of that place.
Shang, whose style was Yisheng or Qiuqing, came from a family that had lived in Xinzheng for two generations and thus became a native of that place.
或字秋卿 is courtesy name Qiuqing (秋卿); idiomatic Qiujing corrupts the pinyin, and the literal already has Qiuqing.
During the Dazhong reign he rose to left vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
During the Dazhong reign he rose by successive promotions to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
尚書左丞 is Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs (尚書省), not a Ministry of Personnel (吏部) vice-ministership; 擢累 is also rightly reflected as successive promotions.
In the Dazhong era he was repeatedly promoted to Left Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
In the Dazhong era he was repeatedly promoted to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
Literal likewise misassigns 尚書左丞 to the Ministry of Personnel; Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs is the correct office.
Early in Qianning he again directed the government, rising to junior tutor of the heir apparent and Duke of Qi.
Early in Qianning he again directed the government, rising to Grand Guardian and Duke of Qi.
進位太保 names the Three Dukes honor Grand Guardian; junior tutor of the heir apparent would require 太子太保, which the Chinese does not have.
Early in Qianning he again held state power, advanced to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Qi.
Early in Qianning he again held state power, advanced to Grand Guardian and Duke of Qi.
Literal likewise expands 太保 into Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Grand Guardian matches bare 太保.
